title: This new AI tool creates motion graphics in seconds
description:
This new AI tool creates motion graphics in seconds. Most motion design tools come with a steep price tag and take hours to learn. But here, you just describe the animation and seconds later you've got professional motion graphics you can use anywhere. The coolest part — you can upload your own logo or image, and the AI animates it automatically.

#ai #motiongraphics #motiondesign #aitools #aivideo #aianimation #contentcreation #videoediting
